title: Aquarian Catholic Spiritual Community: 'Bernadette Roberts Talks Available' (notice, Sept 2021)
description: Notice that the recorded retreat talks Roberts gave over her lifetime 'are now available to view at no cost', linking to the viewing site (URL not exposed in search snippets) and warning that the talks are long; recommends re-watching and taking notes. The retreat named is 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism' (Trinity, Christ, Faith).

title: The 2021 'free online' retreat recordings: identification (lead)
duration: c. 9 h in total (DVD set) if complete
description: Best available identification of the 2021 release: no Google Drive, Vimeo or blog-hosted copy surfaced, and bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com still lists the DVD set (Talk #1-#4) for sale and still states that no online recordings are authorised. The only free viewing route found is the YouTube series of 'Bernadette Roberts on ...' clips cut from the 4-hour/9-hour 'Essence of Christian Mysticism' DVDs, gathered in the playlist 'Bernadette Roberts' ('the most original and controversial mystic of all time'); clip descriptions link to www.bernadetterobertsisnotmyguru.com, the site of Phoenix Kennedy, author of five books on her. Inference: the 2021 'free' release is this unauthorised clip series/playlist, not a release by Bernadette's Friends. Needs a page fetch of the Aquarian post's outbound link to confirm.

title: bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com: Recorded Talks page (DVD/CD)
description: Still lists 'The Essence of Christian Mysticism' as Talk #1-#4 (nine hours in 4 files, handouts Bernadette asked to accompany the talks) and 'A Passage Through Self' (1994 VHS origin) as the DVD set; no free-viewing link in snippets; the site still says no online recordings are authorised. Whether orders are still fulfilled after Patricia Masters' death (May 2024) is unknown.

title: bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com: operators
description: The home page thanks Ramesh Balakrishnan for setting the site up and says Pat Masters manages it; a later note says Patricia Masters, who managed the site for many years, died peacefully on 31 May 2024. The site was created by friends who knew Roberts since the early 1980s; reports her death 27 Nov 2017 at home in Southern California after an ALS diagnosis a year earlier. Who now holds the DVD masters is not stated.

title: bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com: Books page
description: Lists her books; carries the warning that she asked no one to order The Real Christ before reading the warning on the page.

title: bernadetteroberts.blogspot.com: Papers for Download page

title: bernadettesfriends.blogspot.com (Bernadette's Friends)

title: Non-duality as a Definition of Christ (paper presented at SAND, San Jose, 22 Oct 2015)
description: Title page: 'Paper Presented at the SAND Conference - Science and Nonduality - San Jose, California'. Argues the unitive state is not nondual and man's oneness with God does not make him God. Reworked as the essay 'Christ as the Definition of Non-duality' in The Christian Contemplative Journey (2017). No SAND video of the session surfaced; SAND archive has a speaker page for her.

title: SAND archive speaker page: Bernadette Roberts
description: Speaker page exists on the SAND archive site; whether it carries a session video is not shown in snippets (SAND YouTube channel returned nothing for her).

title: What is Self? A Research Paper — Journal of Consciousness Studies 23(1-2), Jan/Feb 2016, p. 80
description: Published in JCS vol. 23 no. 1-2 (2016) at p. 80 in the section of 'target papers by spiritual masters'. Preface: written at the request of Dr Nini Praetorius, Docent Professor, University of Copenhagen, for her research project on a new approach to the self; thesis: 'self is the cause of individuation'. Free PDF on her blog and on o-meditation.com.

title: nonduality.com/berna.htm (Jerry Katz outline of The Experience of No-Self)
description: Katz's outline of The Experience of No-Self; a 26-page PDF print of the page (dated 23 Dec 2011) is mirrored at kundaliniandcelltowers.com. No Wayback capture confirmed by search. Katz's anthology 'One: Essential Writings on Nonduality' includes her and a reader's comment that she 'misses the essential insights of Advaita'.

title: bernadetterobertsisnotmyguru.com (Phoenix Kennedy)
description: Site 'devoted to her work' linked from the YouTube clip descriptions and recommended by spiritualteachers.org; a commenter says the first half of all of Kennedy's books about her can be downloaded free there. Own pages did not surface in search; operator affiliation with her estate: none (her friends' site disowns all online recordings).

title: Phoenix Kennedy's books on Bernadette Roberts
description: Titles: 'Bernadette Roberts is not my guru! An introduction to, and exploration of, her amazing writings' (Goodreads 34570077); 'Bernadette Roberts - God's Big Experiment' (ASIN B07BVJHDCL; 2020 re-issue B0848S946N); 'The Essential Bernadette Roberts: in her own words' (B0965QM3MY, chronological excerpt anthology); 'A Study Guide for The Real Christ'; 'The Unofficial Study Guide to ...'. Amazon reviewers say Kennedy wrote despite her repeated requests that he not do so.

title: Jim Marion / Philip St. Romain dialogue (shalomplace.com PDF)
description: Marion: he wrote about 'the American Catholic contemplative Bernadette Roberts, a former nun' in Putting on the Mind of Christ, regards her no-self experience as authentic; St. Romain: 'I know her and we've corresponded extensively', and mentions a theology-forum thread he featured on her. A Goodreads review says Marion references Roberts and disagrees where he thinks she has not explained herself well. No verbatim Marion passage quoting her surfaced (Google Books: no preview).

title: Ken Wilber: direct citations of Roberts — negative result
description: Two searches across One Taste, Sex Ecology Spirituality, Integral Spirituality, Grace and Grit, Integral Psychology, The Eye of Spirit, A Brief History of Everything and Transformations of Consciousness found no indexed Wilber passage naming her; only a bookseller blurb on What Is Self? and a Shalom Place poster claiming Wilber 'adopted her testimony as an example of Christian nonduality'. Indexes must be checked in print.

title: Jeff Shore foreword to What Is Self? (Sentient Publications, 2005)
description: Front matter: Foreword by Jeff Shore, followed by a foreword by Ric Williams. Shore's publications page (beingwithoutself.org) confirms the credit. The Path to No-Self has a foreword by Thomas Keating instead.

title: Douglas Lockhart, 'Bernadette Roberts & the No-Self' (essay, 2019)
description: Copyright 2019 Douglas Lockhart; listed on his Religion page as 'a new essay'; has a section 'The Jesus Problem'; calls her stage writings among the most original contributions in a Christian context. Not part of Jesus the Heretic or The Dark Side of God as far as search shows.

title: Shalom Place thread: Bernadette Roberts on Buddhism, No-Ego, and No-Self
